text: So sorry to bother you, I'm a childminder and I've got a 7 year old girl staying with me overnight while her parents are away. She's got a temp of 39.4 and a runny nose, sneezing a lot. Theres a rash on her tummy but I did the glass thing and it went pale straight away when I pressed. Her colour is normal, lips look normal too. Her cheeks are really red but that started after she was running around outside in the freezing wind this afternoon so I think its just from that, they were the same when my own kids played out in the cold. Im probably overthinking it, I just dont want to get it wrong with someone elses child. Sorry again
